heroHeadline: Day 667: OFAC Sanctions 11 Chapitos Crypto Launderers + 6 Ethereum Wallets; Extradition Standoff Day 22 — 7 Officials Including Rocha Moya Remain in Mexico
heroSubtitle: 667 days of cartel civil war — May 20: US Treasury OFAC designated 11 Sinaloa Cartel Los Chapitos money launderers and 2 entities (Gorditas Chiwas restaurant; Grupo Especial Mamba Negra security firm) as financial fronts, adding 6 Ethereum wallet addresses to the SDN list in the most advanced cryptocurrency enforcement action targeting the cartel to date. Central figure Armando de Jesus Ojeda Aviles ran a cash-to-crypto pipeline converting US drug sales cash into USDT stablecoins via unlicensed OTC brokers; one flagged ETH wallet was active as recently as April 27, 2026. A State Department companion statement simultaneously designated two Chapitos fentanyl trafficking networks. May 21: Extradition standoff enters Day 22 — three of ten SDNY-indicted officials (Mérida Sánchez, Díaz Vega, Inzunza Cazárez) are in US federal custody at Brooklyn MDC; seven including Governor Rocha Moya and Mayor Gámez Mendívil remain in Mexico while FGR reviews the US evidence package. The May 20 OFAC action is the fourth major US financial enforcement strike since April 20 (visa restrictions → Apr 24 OFAC precursor sanctions → Apr 29 SDNY indictment → May 20 crypto sanctions). La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops deployed; El Mayo EDNY sentencing July 20, 2026; Ovidio NDIL sentencing July 27. NGO Sabuesos Unidas: ~5,800 disappearances since Sep 2024; running homicide toll ~2,425+ (Noroeste) / 3,000+ (WSJ).
